data.text: LISTEN plays the piece; the arrows move a bar
Turn the data wheel on the list and push it to load, or tap a file and LOAD. The folder becomes PLAY's
piece list (tap the title there). ADD TO LIST builds the Playlist, the last folder. Your own files: the MIDI
loader on your computer (see the README); the list updates by itself.
These must match the LinnStrument so a light lands on the right cell: its size, its Row Offset (Global Settings), the note of the bottom-left cell (F#1 by default; it moves with
the Octave and Transpose settings) and Left-Handed. Played-colour highlights also need Linn Ch to be a channel the instrument plays on: in MPE mode a per-note channel
(2-16), in One Channel mode that channel. To use the MIDI jacks instead of USB, set the LinnStrument's MIDI I/O to MIDI Jacks and LINN's Linn Port to MPC Out A or B. Linn
Octave and Linn Transp follow the instrument's Octave and Transpose (Read Transp on: asked every few seconds over USB), so colours and fingering land on the right cells
Note Colors puts a dot of each note's colour in every notehead still to be played. Feedback: notes you play turn green, missed notes red, and a wrong note shows as a red note where you played it.
The colours match the LinnStrument's; black keys get the hue between their neighbours (D# a deeper blue than D).
